subject.title: Feature Request: Add custom client display name for TUI

question: Should OpenClaw expose a user-facing TUI display-name override, and if so should it be CLI-only, persisted config-backed, or auto-derived?
rationale: The implementation is technically straightforward through the existing Gateway `clientDisplayName` seam, but the choice creates a public CLI/config-adjacent identity surface and has privacy implications for Gateway-visible metadata.

options.title: Add CLI-Only Opt-In Flag
options.body: Add a bounded `openclaw tui --client-name <name>` path for Gateway mode only, keep the existing default unchanged, and document privacy-safe usage.

options.title: Add persisted TUI config
options.body: Add a `tui` config key if maintainers want a stable per-user default, with schema/docs/tests and no upgrade surprise for existing users.

options.title: Defer Or Decline
options.body: Keep `openclaw-tui` as the only TUI label until a broader identity and privacy policy is decided.

recommendation.title: Add CLI-Only Opt-In Flag
recommendation.body: Add a bounded `openclaw tui --client-name <name>` path for Gateway mode only, keep the existing default unchanged, and document privacy-safe usage.

likelyOwner.reason: The current `openclaw` label traces to the rename commit and the unresolved choice is public CLI/product behavior.
